authorization: User requested review, fixes, unchanged functions, proper testing and live release in this chat.

diagnosis.shopify: Saved product receipt error explicitly reports GraphQL THROTTLED. API helper previously failed immediately without a capacity wait/retry.
diagnosis.allocation: Repeated P0001 refusal belongs to an exhausted edition: total100, sold100, remaining0, next101, run sold_out. Allocator correctly refuses new units; shared disabled/archived/sold-out message was misclassified as Error rather than Sold Out.
diagnosis.read_only_live_validation: The fresh exhausted-run predicate evaluated true on the affected product. No customer records, credentials or production payloads were copied into test fixtures.

changes: At most three identical attempts for explicit HTTP429 or all-THROTTLED GraphQL errors with no data. Respect Retry-After and cost restoration; at most ten seconds per wait. Long/malformed waits and exhausted retries return to existing durable job retry handling.
Do not replay network timeouts, HTTP5xx, authentication errors, mixed GraphQL errors or partial GraphQL results.

After allocator rollback, classify only the exact shared P0001 refusal using fresh consistent exhausted-product/run state. No counter or run writes. Existing Sold Out presentation and unresolved-line retry/review behavior are retained.
Diagnostic read/rollback failures preserve the original allocator error. Unexpected allocation failures remain failures.
preserved: HMAC and shop validation, eligibility, credentials and permissions
Atomic RPC, uniqueness, source identity, quantity checks and idempotency
Numbering, edition limits, sales counters, version/history guards and tombstones
Certificates, inventory, publication and product workflows
Existing review/retry paths; no automatic new edition or sold-out override
Render topology, plans, schema and production dependencies

tests.suite: Capacity regression, allocation diagnostics, Shopify client, activation, isolated PostgreSQL onboarding, ledger, cursor, marketplace, receiver health and worker supervision
tests.note: Legacy SQLite-only tests remain skipped. One obsolete Render Blueprint assertion excluded after reproducing the identical failure on unmodified base modules and unchanged render.yaml.

tests.suite: Edition versions and cursor overrides on disposable PostgreSQL
tests.note: Existing disposable_read_connection adapter supplied for read leases; original harness only patched write connection and initially failed four read checks for missing production URL. No production URL was supplied.
Includes duplicate delivery, quantity, rollback, sold-out closure, reserved numbers and variant identity. PGlite serializes connections; this is not cross-process PostgreSQL lock stress evidence.

runtime.pglast: 8.9 local test-only target; missing dependency corrected before final suite
runtime.external_actions: All Shopify requests mocked. No live writes, emails, ads, customer automations, replay or full-app preview during testing.

validation: Shopify rate-limit documentation verified for pinned2026-04 API; no GraphQL operations changed
limitations: Exhausted edition requires an operator decision for the unallocated order; code cannot legitimately allocate101/100. This release corrects the state/error classification, not the sale itself.
Shopify can continue throttling under sustained load; bounded retries and existing durable backoff remain necessary.
No claim that every repository test passes: the obsolete Blueprint assertion is documented separately.
